# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release and the `main` branch are actively maintained and supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | Yes                |
| < 0.1.0 | No                 |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this repository, please do not file a public issue.

Instead, please report it via [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/shiliaiwei/mini-application/security/advisories/new) or contact the project maintainers directly.

All reports will be acknowledged within 48 hours, and critical fixes will be prioritized immediately.
